dialog.stopBody: Stopping the hub will disconnect all POS terminals until you start it again. Are you sure?
dialog.updateReady: An update is ready. Restart now to apply?

setup.title: Connection to Odoo
setup.intro: The hub sends orders to Odoo as this user. Use a user created only for this hub, not a person's login or admin.
setup.passwordKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
setup.userHint: Add the user to the POS Hub Service group so logins keep working when Odoo can't be reached.
setup.saved: Connected. The hub is restarting with these settings.
setup.noHubGroup: This user isn't in POS Hub Service: the hub works, but logins stop when Odoo can't be reached.
setup.storedInKeychain: The password is saved in this computer's credential store.
setup.storedInFile: The credential store isn't available, so the password is saved in a protected file only this user account can read.
setup.hubRefused: The hub refused its Odoo settings:

errors.invalidUrl: Enter the full address, starting with http:// or https://.
errors.defaultPassword: That password is a well-known default. The hub refuses it; set a strong password for this user in Odoo.
errors.unreachable: Couldn't reach Odoo at that address.
errors.notOdoo: That address answered, but it doesn't look like Odoo.
errors.badLogin: Odoo rejected the user or password.
errors.odooError: Odoo returned an error (check the database name).
errors.storeFailed: Couldn't save the settings on this computer.
